_meta.description: Illustrative scenario presets for the Scenario Lab. These are ASSUMPTIONS, not forecasts or management guidance. Base quarter = Q3 2026 actuals. Model: revenue path from QoQ growth with decay; usage = revenue ÷ price index; required compute = serving × usage ÷ efficiency + research compute growing at its own rate; committed compute follows an illustrative obligation profile calibrated to disclosed anchors ($69.8B next 12 months; $447.5B before 2031; $895.4B total); shortfall bought at a premium; cash margin = 1 − compute/revenue − other cash opex %.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Frontier leadership holds; agents scale beyond coding; committed capacity is absorbed by 2028 and Anthropic Direct lowers unit costs.

base.label: Base
base.narrative: Growth normalizes (≈+115% in 2027, ≈+20% by 2030); prices fall ~25%/yr; committed capacity front-runs demand in 2027–28, compressing margins before recovering.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: Differentiation compresses, routing layers commoditize models, prices fall faster than usage grows; fixed commitments drive losses and require new capital or renegotiation.
